title: Portfolio exclusion list
description: Two-axis exclusion list. repoNames excludes by folder name during the directory scan (before a slug exists); slugs excludes by manifest slug on the public site (after a repo is fingerprinted). Written by `drift exclude <slug>` for the slugs array; repoNames is maintained by hand.

repoNames.description: Repository folder names excluded from the directory scan. Used to filter out the portfolio repo itself, non-project repos, split-product sub-repos, and companion repos that are not tracked separately.

slugs.description: Project slugs (matching sources.json keys) excluded from the public site. A slug here is absent from the projects array, all filter views, the map, the timeline, the sitemap, and OG prerender.
